subject: P2-21.1 Native Target missing-capability fill-in (TLL -> C lowering + dual-target conformance)

toolchain.tllc_native: tools/TLLC/tllc_native.tllbc (196 functions, rebuilt, git-ignored build artifact)

fixes_applied.desc: User-defined function names are prefixed tll_fn_ in generated C (forward decl, definition, call site) to avoid C stdlib/macro collisions (e.g. max). main maps to tll_main.
fixes_applied.verified_by: batch1_basic: generated C shows tll_fn_add/tll_fn_max/tll_fn_isEven; cl.exe 0 errors; EXE output identical to bytecode (42/true/false/20/30/42/4)

fixes_applied.desc: Test-only verification APIs (tll_debug_refcount, tll_debug_print_refcount) are excluded from the prefix rule and from caller-retains-arguments incref protection, matching their builtin-like C ABI.
fixes_applied.verified_by: 19_refcount_machine_evidence: cl.exe links clean; native rc transitions match expected semantics (1/1/2/2/1/1/2/2/2/2/3/3/3)

dual_target_matrix.method: tests/native 07-20 compared per-target against committed *_bytecode.out / *_native.out baselines; 01-06, cross_target_minimal and native/conformance 4 cases compared bytecode-vs-native output after CRLF normalization

refcount_semantics_probe.note: tll_debug_print_refcount is a native-runtime probe; native EXE prints real object refcounts. Expected transitions all verified.

known_gap.desc: bytecode VM does not implement the tll_debug_print_refcount probe (no output; not registered in host/c builtin dispatch). The probe exists only in the native runtime (runtime/value.c). 19_refcount_machine_evidence is therefore a native-only probe test; its bytecode baseline intentionally contains no [REFCOUNT] lines.
known_gap.decision: Documented as identified gap; VM probe implementation deferred (touches self-hosting chain, requires user adjudication).
